name: search-bar
title: Search Bar
description: Search field with a soft focus halo: the magnifier pops on focus, Cancel slides in as the field springs narrower, the clear button scales in and a spinning arc shows loading. Suggestions drop down in an animated panel with recent / trending icons and the matching text in bold; a trailing slot fits a filter or mic button. The minimal variant expands from a round icon.
summary: Focus pops the magnifier and springs in Cancel; suggestions drop down below.
behavior: On focus a halo glows and the magnifier pops; Cancel slides in as the field springs narrower and the clear button scales in. loading swaps the magnifier for a spinning arc.
The 'minimal' variant rests as a round icon and expands into a full field when tapped. Picking a suggestion fills the query and dismisses the keyboard.
The input has the search role, labelled by its placeholder. 'Clear search', Cancel and each suggestion are labelled buttons.
The browser outline is replaced by the border and halo, and the suggestion panel stays open a beat after blur so clicks land.
props: Outlined pill, iOS grey field, or a round icon that expands into a field.
34 / 44 / 56pt tall; font, icons, padding and radius scale too.
